title: LLM-as-judge for stored rationales
why: A rubric-based LLM grader, calibrated against a small human-labelled set, is the standard way teams evaluate open-ended LLM output at scale.
limits: The judge model is the same family as the forecasters it grades, so it may favour their style.
At most 30 human labels: the agreement estimate is rough.
It grades the stated reasoning, not whether the forecast turned out right.
